'''''Testament''''' was the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] around [[3963 BBY]]. Commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Telettoh]], the ship made a stop on the planet [[Wor Tandell/Legends|Wor Tandell]], where Telettoh and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]] were looking for [[Zayne Carrick]] and his band of renegades, before departing on the front line of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].
